Ooredoo الجزائر تنظم يومًا تحسيسيًا وترف: Ooredoo Algeria organizes an awareness and recreational day for the early detection of prostate cancer
وفاءً منها لالتزامها الراسخ تجاه رفاهية: True to its steadfast commitment to the well-being and health of its employees, Ooredoo organized, on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, a day dedicated to awareness and prevention of prostate cancer, as part of the global "Blue November" campaign.
وبهذه المناسبة، هيّأت المؤسسة فضاءً للرا: On this occasion, the company set up a relaxation and recreation space specially designed for its male employees. This space provided an opportunity to share moments of enjoyment through a variety of recreational and sports activities made available to them, such as table tennis (ping-pong), billiards, video games, as well as dart throwing, among other leisure activities.
ومزجاً بين الترفيه والوقاية الطبية، أتاح: Combining entertainment with medical prevention, Ooredoo also offered its employees the opportunity to undergo medical examinations for the early detection of prostate cancer.
تندرج هذه المبادرة المواطِنة في سياق است: This civic initiative is part of the continuity of the company's corporate social responsibility initiatives in the field of occupational health. It follows the "Pink October" campaign held within the company last month, during which Ooredoo's female employees benefited from awareness sessions and preventive diagnostics against breast cancer.
كما تُعزّز هذه المبادرة تقليداً راسخاً م: This initiative also reinforces a strong tradition of commitment, as Ooredoo previously organized a similar prostate cancer screening campaign for its employees in 2024, in partnership with the National Patient Assistance Association (Win Nalka).
ومن خلال هذه المبادرات المتجددة، تؤكد Oo: Through these renewed initiatives, Ooredoo reaffirms its dedication to placing the human element at the core of its priorities, and sustainably embedding a culture of prevention and well-being within its professional environment.
